title: Man Attempts to Flee Police But Totals His Car From a Deer
description:
On November 14, 2020, a Monroe County deputy observed a vehicle traveling 95 mph in a 55 mph zone in Kendall, WI. The deputy tried to conduct a traffic stop but the vehicle fled throughout two counties. Unfortunately for the suspect, he didn't have the best luck that night and the pursuit ended quickly.
